# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The canonical agent instructions live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md); the conventions it
indexes are in [.claude/rules/](../.claude/rules/). Follow them.

This file exists only so GitHub Copilot auto-discovers the shared rules; do not
duplicate rule content here. When a convention changes, edit `AGENTS.md` (or the
relevant file under `.claude/rules/`, `.claude/skills/` and `.doc/`), never this pointer.
